name: Suanni: Man Chai
description:
The attached character's Elemental Skill spends 1 fewer Elemental Die and deals +1 DMG.
When the attached character uses an Elemental Skill: If their current HP is 5 or higher, they don't spend Usage(s). Instead, they take 1 Piercing DMG.
Usage(s): 2
